bg_en: You were a solitary hermit tending a sacred grove until raiders burned it. You still hunt them and the seeds they stole.
News has it that a noble in the next town over is hunting a rare magical stag.
A wanderer raised by animals, your integration into intelligent society has been rocky.
For the last year, your recurring nightmare features an aggressive, reddish fungal blight.
Your people tended a desert oasis until a mage’s curse dried its waters. You hope to one day discover the curse-giver’s identity.
You found and returned the queen’s runaway dog; now you wonder if you should’ve kept it.
Rumors suggest that a long-vanished society of druids has become active again.
types.bundle_en: Choose the following equipment bundle to quickly outfit your character, or assemble your own starting equipment. A quarterstaff, a bow and quiver of 12 arrows, appropriate clothing, leather armor, a backpack, a bedroll, 50 feet (16 m) of rope, a tent, a candle, three days of rations and water, a tinderbox, and enough extra currency to buy a moderately priced item.
types.bundle_es: Un bastón, un arco con carcaj de 12 flechas, ropa adecuada, armadura de cuero, una mochila, un saco de dormir, 16 m de cuerda, una tienda, una vela, raciones y agua para tres días, un yesquero y dinero suficiente para comprar un objeto de precio moderado.

abilities.text_en: You gain a follower that is a level 2 beast of your size or smaller that accompanies you and follows your instructions. You and your GM must work out the appearance and personality of your beast. Its movement is based on its creature type (avian, swimmer, and so on). If your beast companion dies, you can use your resource points to revive them or (by hunting in the wild for a few days) locate and befriend a new one. Enabler.
abilities.text_es: Ganas un seguidor: una bestia de nivel 2 de tu tamaño o menor que te acompaña y sigue tus instrucciones. Decide con el DJ su aspecto y personalidad. Se mueve según su tipo de criatura (voladora, nadadora, etc.). Si muere, puedes usar tus puntos de recurso para revivirla o (cazando unos días en la naturaleza) encontrar y ganarte otra. Enabler.

abilities.text_en: A type of small creature you name that exists in the surrounding environment (such as insects, rats, bats, or birds) comes under your influence if you succeed on a difficulty 2 Intellect task for outdoor survival. Affected creatures within short range will not harm you or those you designate as allies until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery. This ability doesn’t work against hostile swarms of creatures of level 3 or higher. Your creatures—even common insects (level 0)—can swarm in large-enough numbers to hinder the attacks or defenses of a single target, or take some other action. You can use this ability to calm or command vines, grass blades, creepers, roots, or branches of nearby plants instead of animals. Effort: Your creatures collectively respond to your commands as an NPC ally. Action.
abilities.text_es: Un tipo de criatura pequeña que nombres y que viva en el entorno (insectos, ratas, murciélagos, pájaros…) queda bajo tu influencia si superas una tarea de Intelecto de supervivencia (outdoor survival) de dificultad 2. Las criaturas afectadas a alcance corto no os harán daño a ti ni a quien designes como aliado hasta que hagas una recuperación de diez minutos o más. No funciona contra enjambres hostiles de nivel 3 o superior. Tus criaturas (incluso insectos comunes, de nivel 0) pueden agolparse en número suficiente para dificultar los ataques o defensas de un objetivo, o hacer otra acción. También puedes usarla para calmar o mandar sobre enredaderas, hierbas, raíces o ramas de plantas cercanas en vez de animales. Esfuerzo: tus criaturas responden en conjunto a tus órdenes como un aliado PNJ. Acción.

abilities.text_en: You throw a handful of seeds in the air that ignite and speed toward a target within long range, scratching the air with twisting smoke trails. A successful attack deals 3 damage and catches the target on fire, inflicting +1 damage per round until the target uses an action to douse the flames or until you’ve taken your next recovery. Action.
abilities.text_es: Lanzas al aire un puñado de semillas que prenden y vuelan hacia un objetivo a alcance largo dejando estelas de humo retorcido. Un ataque con éxito hace 3 de daño y prende fuego al objetivo, que recibe +1 de daño por asalto hasta que use una acción para apagarse o hasta que hagas tu siguiente recuperación. Acción.

types.intro_en: Weapon tightly gripped, you charge your monstrous foes. Anyone willing to hold a sword might be called a “fighter,” but you’re a cut above most. Less well-trained warriors may serve as soldiers, guards, and muscle in a tavern, but a Fighter truly understands conflict and battlefield control. You’ve trained in specific weapons and methods of defense, have scars from past fights, and probably look forward to your next descent into an ancient ruin or enemy’s outpost, if only so you can match your weapon against a foe’s blade or spell. In your group, you’re usually the most physically capable, the most durable, and the most ready to meet danger head-on. This attribute probably leads to a role as a protector of your friends—particularly the least sturdy among them. If someone has to take the lead when entering the monster’s den, you’re among the first to charge in.
types.intro_es: Con el arma bien agarrada, cargas contra tus monstruosos enemigos. Cualquiera dispuesto a empuñar una espada puede llamarse «guerrero», pero tú estás por encima de la mayoría. Los menos entrenados sirven de soldados, guardias o matones de taberna, pero un Guerrero de verdad entiende el conflicto y el control del campo de batalla. Te has entrenado en armas y formas de defensa concretas, tienes cicatrices de peleas pasadas y seguramente esperas con ganas tu próximo descenso a unas ruinas antiguas o a un puesto enemigo, aunque solo sea para medir tu arma con la hoja o el conjuro de un rival. En tu grupo sueles ser el más capaz físicamente, el más resistente y el más dispuesto a afrontar el peligro de cara. Eso te lleva a proteger a tus amigos, sobre todo a los menos robustos. Si alguien tiene que ir delante al entrar en la guarida del monstruo, tú eres de los primeros.

bg_en: You lost your childhood home in war and only survived because you fought. Now, years later, you still seek out the last remnants of the enemy army.
You’ve only recently recovered from a major wound after a giant ambushed you.
People still occasionally recognize you as the winner of a local combat tournament.
You were a captain during the war, but after the kingdom lost, you kept a low profile.
Your sibling died exploring a haunted keep. Their sword passed to you three days ago.
The constabulary discharged you a few months ago, and you’re still not sure why.
The war was long and bloody, but now it’s finally over, and you need work.
You came up as a city guard—until the city was sacked. Now you seek to redeem yourself by safeguarding those less sturdy than you.  50   CHAPTER 6  FANTASY GENRE   Fighter Equipment Bundle
types.bundle_en: Choose the following equipment bundle to quickly outfit your character, or assemble your own starting equipment. A sword, appropriate clothing, chainmail armor, a shield, a backpack, a bedroll, 50 feet (16 m) of rope, spikes and hammer set, two torches, three days of rations and water, a tinderbox, and enough extra currency to buy a moderately priced item.
types.bundle_es: Una espada, ropa adecuada, cota de malla, un escudo, una mochila, un saco de dormir, 16 m de cuerda, un juego de clavos y martillo, dos antorchas, raciones y agua para tres días, un yesquero y dinero suficiente para comprar un objeto de precio moderado.

abilities.text_en: You are trained in a specific weapon attack of your choice, such as swords, axes, or bows; or in a broader category of attacks, such as light bashing weapons, light bladed weapons, light ranged weapons, medium bashing weapons, medium bladed weapons, medium ranged weapons, and so on. At tier 2: You can choose to become specialized in the same attack method you chose at tier 1, but you must gain the skill normally (such as from a character advancement). At tier 6: You can become an expert in a specific attack method (either the one you chose at tier 1 or another weapon skill you’re already specialized in), but you must gain the skill normally.
abilities.text_es: Quedas entrenado en un ataque con arma concreto a tu elección (espadas, hachas, arcos…) o en una categoría más amplia (armas contundentes ligeras, armas cortantes ligeras, armas a distancia ligeras, armas contundentes medias, cortantes medias, a distancia medias, etc.). En el rango 2: puedes especializarte en ese mismo método de ataque, pero tienes que ganar la habilidad de la forma normal (por ejemplo, con un avance). En el rango 6: puedes hacerte experto en un método de ataque concreto (el que elegiste en el rango 1 u otra habilidad de arma en la que ya estés especializado), pero tienes que ganarla de la forma normal.

abilities.text_en: When your damage-dealing attack roll is 17 or higher, you deal +1 damage with the attack. If you roll a 19 or 20, you inflict the extra damage regardless of whether you choose to deal additional damage or take a special minor or major effect.
abilities.text_es: Cuando tu tirada de ataque que hace daño es 17 o más, haces +1 de daño. Si sacas 19 o 20, haces ese daño extra tanto si eliges daño adicional como si eliges un efecto menor o mayor especial.

abilities.text_en: Once per turn if you take down a foe, you can immediately make another attack on that same turn against a new foe within your reach as an extra action on your turn. You can use this ability with melee attacks and ranged attacks. Enabler.
abilities.text_es: Una vez por turno, si derribas a un enemigo, puedes hacer de inmediato otro ataque en ese mismo turno contra otro enemigo a tu alcance, como acción extra de tu turno. Sirve con ataques cuerpo a cuerpo y a distancia. Enabler.

types.intro_en: You cast spells of blasting fire, magical protection, and force at a distance. As a spellcaster, you’re always on the lookout for new arcane secrets, magic lore, and spells you can add to your repertoire. You understand that the most powerful spells—those that can alter a creature’s form, open pathways to other worlds, or kill with a single word—are jealously guarded secrets even among friendly spellcasters, including between master and apprentice. But that only makes you willing to brave nearly any threat to search for such things, even in dangerous locations far below ground. You’re happy to rely on the physical protection provided by others in your group who are more armed and armored, leaving more esoteric threats and puzzles to your elevated talents. And any time potentially enchanted loot or treasure is discovered, others in the group are likely hoping you, with your intelligence and experience, can explain their function. That’s not to say you’re not a threat in your own right—you know at least one spell capable of magically blasting foes, and if you survive, you hope to learn even more.
types.intro_es: Lanzas conjuros de fuego devastador, protección mágica y fuerza a distancia. Como lanzador de conjuros, siempre buscas nuevos secretos arcanos, saber mágico y conjuros para tu repertorio. Sabes que los conjuros más poderosos (los que alteran la forma de una criatura, abren caminos a otros mundos o matan con una sola palabra) son secretos celosamente guardados incluso entre lanzadores amigos, también entre maestro y aprendiz. Pero eso solo te hace estar dispuesto a afrontar casi cualquier amenaza para buscarlos, incluso en lugares peligrosos bajo tierra. Te conformas con la protección física de quienes van más armados y acorazados, y dejas para tu talento las amenazas y enigmas más esotéricos. Y cada vez que aparece un botín o tesoro posiblemente encantado, el resto del grupo espera que tú, con tu inteligencia y experiencia, expliques para qué sirve. Eso no quiere decir que no seas peligroso: conoces al menos un conjuro capaz de fulminar enemigos y, si sobrevives, esperas aprender muchos más.

bg_en: You spent your early years studying in a magical academy, until a covetous god sent her followers to sack it.
A few days ago, the spellcaster you apprenticed under was murdered.
You apprenticed under a cruel teacher who you barely managed to escape—but he still seeks you after all these years.
You bid on a rare book of arcane lore at last week’s auction but lost to a masked wizard.
A trinket your sister called her lucky charm was delivered to you yesterday with no note.
You learned your spells from an old book left to you by your uncle who disappeared mysteriously, and you still keep an eye out for news about him.
More by accident than choice, you saved the life of the mayor’s adventure-seeking son.
A demon who taught you one of your spells showed up last week to call in a favor.
types.bundle_en: Choose the following equipment bundle to quickly outfit your character, or assemble your own starting equipment. A dagger, appropriate clothing, a spellbook (which also serves as a field journal for taking arcane notes), pen, ink, a backpack, a bedroll, 50 feet (16 m) of rope, matchsticks (10), a magnifying glass, three torches, three days of rations and water, two flasks of oil, and enough extra currency to buy a moderately priced item.
types.bundle_es: Una daga, ropa adecuada, un libro de conjuros (que también sirve de cuaderno de campo para notas arcanas), pluma, tinta, una mochila, un saco de dormir, 16 m de cuerda, cerillas (10), una lupa, tres antorchas, raciones y agua para tres días, dos frascos de aceite y dinero suficiente para comprar un objeto de precio moderado.

abilities.text_en: You emit a short-range blast of energy inflicting 4 damage on a target with a successful attack roll. Work with the GM to determine the type of energy comprising your blast. You can tune the effect to make it hot enough to slice through material of up to level 5 that’s no more than 1 foot (30 cm) thick if given a few rounds to concentrate on doing so. If you have another damaging attack ability (from this focus or your type), you can use Blast to augment that ability, increasing its damage by 1. Effort: Gain fine control over the effect until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery, varying the intensity as you wish within immediate range; for instance, you could use it to warm the area, cook food without burning it, provide bright light in the area, and so on. Increase the maximum level of material that you can cut through by 1. Action to attack; Last action to initiate fine control; enabler to augment another attack ability.
abilities.text_es: Emites una descarga de energía a alcance corto que hace 4 de daño a un objetivo si aciertas el ataque. Decide con el DJ qué tipo de energía es. Si te concentras unos asaltos, puedes ajustarla para que corte material de hasta nivel 5 y no más de 30 cm de grosor. Si tienes otra habilidad de ataque que hace daño (de tu foco o tu tipo), puedes usar Descarga para reforzarla y sumarle 1 de daño. Esfuerzo: ganas control fino del efecto hasta que hagas una recuperación de diez minutos o más, variando la intensidad a voluntad a alcance inmediato; por ejemplo, para calentar la zona, cocinar sin quemar o dar luz intensa. Aumenta en 1 el nivel máximo de material que puedes cortar. Acción para atacar; última acción para iniciar el control fino; enabler para reforzar otra habilidad de ataque.

abilities.text_en: An invisible field of energy surrounds you until you use a ten-hour recovery. This allows you to try blocking attacks with an eased Intellect defense roll instead of a Might defense roll; if you succeed, you reduce the severity of the wound by one step. Action. At tier 3: Your Intellect defense roll to block an attack is eased by two steps total.
abilities.text_es: Te rodea un campo de energía invisible hasta que hagas una recuperación de diez horas. Te permite intentar bloquear ataques con una defensa de Intelecto facilitada en vez de una de Potencia; si tienes éxito, reduces un paso la gravedad de la herida. Acción. En el rango 3: tu defensa de Intelecto para bloquear queda facilitada en dos pasos en total.

abilities.text_en: Each day you can pick a different magical effect and cast it as a spell. Choose a low-power manifest cypher. After spending ten minutes preparing, you gain that cypher’s effect as a spell (a character special ability). You can cast that spell as an action, costing 2 Intellect. This spell does not count toward your cypher limit. Unlike when using a cypher, you do not lose this spell after casting it. As part of making a ten-hour recovery, you can change which cypher you’ve taken as a spell. Changing which cypher you have prepared as a spell ends all of your durations of the previous prepared spell. You can select this ability up to three times (as a character advancement or in place of a new focus ability), allowing you to choose one, two, or three cyphers each day as spells. Ten minutes to prepare a cypher as a spell; action to cast a cypher as a spell. At tier 3: You can use this ability to choose a low- or medium-power cypher as a spell. You can cast a medium-power cypher spell as an action, costing 4 Intellect. At tier 6: You can use this ability to choose a low-, mid-, or advanced-power cypher as a spell. You can cast an advanced-power cypher spell as an action, costing 6 Intellect.
abilities.text_es: Cada día puedes elegir un efecto mágico distinto y lanzarlo como conjuro. Elige una cifra manifiesta de poder bajo; tras diez minutos de preparación, ganas su efecto como conjuro (una habilidad especial). Lanzarlo es una acción y cuesta 2 de Intelecto. No cuenta para tu límite de cifras y, a diferencia de una cifra, no lo pierdes al lanzarlo. Al hacer una recuperación de diez horas puedes cambiar la cifra elegida; hacerlo termina todas las duraciones del conjuro anterior. Puedes coger esta habilidad hasta tres veces (como avance o en lugar de una habilidad de foco nueva), para tener uno, dos o tres conjuros al día. Diez minutos para preparar un conjuro; acción para lanzarlo. En el rango 3: puedes elegir cifras de poder bajo o medio; uno de poder medio cuesta 4 de Intelecto. En el rango 6: puedes elegir cifras de poder bajo, medio o avanzado; uno avanzado cuesta 6 de Intelecto.

types.intro_en: You don’t use weapons—you are a weapon. With powerful punches, kicks, and full-body moves, you inflict incredible damage on your foes. By focusing your energy (sometimes called chi, ki, or just “grit”), you magnify your power and speed. You probably gained your skills through intense training, fighting in real-world tournaments against your peers and betters, and, more recently, putting your unique skills to use in adventuring. Weaponless martial artists are both feared and revered, which means your role in your group is likely unique in one sense. However, you join any other frontline warriors on your team, using your weapons of hand, foot, knee, and elbow far more nimbly than someone swinging around a bulky slab of metal.
types.intro_es: No usas armas: eres un arma. Con puñetazos, patadas y movimientos de todo el cuerpo haces un daño increíble a tus enemigos. Concentrando tu energía (a veces llamada chi, ki o simplemente «coraje») multiplicas tu poder y tu velocidad. Seguramente te formaste con un entrenamiento intenso, combatiendo en torneos reales contra iguales y mejores, y últimamente poniendo tus habilidades únicas al servicio de la aventura. Los artistas marciales sin armas son temidos y venerados, así que tu papel en el grupo es en cierto modo único. Aun así, te unes a los demás combatientes de primera línea, usando tus armas (mano, pie, rodilla y codo) con mucha más agilidad que quien blande un pesado trozo de metal.
ben_en: Able to take three more minor wounds and one more moderate wound
Add +2 to Might Pool
Add +2 to Speed Pool
Add +1 Edge in Pool of your choice
Cannot freely use any armor
At tier 3 and tier 6, choose an ability from the Fantasy Genre Abilities list
ben_es: Puedes recibir tres heridas leves más y una moderada más
+2 a la reserva de Potencia
+2 a la reserva de Velocidad
+1 de Ventaja en la reserva que elijas
No puedes usar libremente ninguna armadura
En los rangos 3 y 6, elige una habilidad de la lista de habilidades del género fantasía
bg_en: Brought up in a secluded monastery, you left before you completed your training and still regret it after all these years.
The master you were training under was called to the capital two weeks ago.
Your old rival appeared in town a few months ago and apparently wants a rematch.
Your entire family was killed when a volcano erupted. Since then you’ve dedicated yourself to destroying primordial and elemental beings, especially those related to fire and earth.
A document you found in a library a year ago claims your family descends from dragons.
Growing up, you never lost a competitive bout in the monthly games in your community, except once. You still search for the one who beat you in hopes of a rematch.
Your close friend disappeared a few months ago, and their debts became your debts.
In off hours, you’ve been studying artful flower arrangement for the last couple of weeks.
types.bundle_en: Choose the following equipment bundle to quickly outfit your character, or assemble your own starting equipment. Appropriate clothing, a backpack, a bedroll, 50 feet (16 m) of rope, a meditation mat, three torches, three days of rations and water, a tinderbox, and enough extra currency to buy an expensive item.
types.bundle_es: Ropa adecuada, una mochila, un saco de dormir, 16 m de cuerda, una esterilla de meditación, tres antorchas, raciones y agua para tres días, un yesquero y dinero suficiente para comprar un objeto caro.

abilities.text_en: After making a light unarmed attack, as an extra action on your turn you make another light unarmed attack against the same target or a different one. Action. At tier 3: You can make a third light unarmed attack as a third action on your turn.
abilities.text_es: Tras hacer un ataque desarmado ligero, como acción extra de tu turno haces otro ataque desarmado ligero contra el mismo objetivo o contra otro. Acción. En el rango 3: puedes hacer un tercer ataque desarmado ligero como tercera acción de tu turno.

abilities.text_en: As a First action, you move up to a short distance and then can take another First action, such as attacking with a light weapon or opening a door (the movement happens before the First action, not the other way around). Unlike a normal situation of taking an action and moving a short distance, this movement doesn’t hinder your tasks. Enabler.
abilities.text_es: Como primera acción, te mueves hasta una distancia corta y luego puedes hacer otra primera acción, como atacar con un arma ligera o abrir una puerta (el movimiento va antes de la primera acción, no al revés). A diferencia de lo normal al actuar y moverte una distancia corta, este movimiento no dificulta tus tareas. Enabler.

abilities.text_en: Your unarmed attacks (such as punches, kicks, elbows, or knees) inflict an additional 2 damage.
abilities.text_es: Tus ataques desarmados (puñetazos, patadas, codazos o rodillazos) hacen 2 de daño adicional.

types.intro_en: Decomposing flesh radiates fading life force. You know how to siphon that power, twist and shape it, then reinfuse the dead with it to return them to ambulatory service. You can also draw that energy directly from them to heal your own rent flesh or anyone near you. In fact, your necromantic prowess gives you a degree of control over undead of all sorts, allowing you to daze and repel them, or even briefly command their service. Because your abilities are so directly tethered to death, many people fear and hate you regardless of your deeds and true motivation. Your animated helpers can aid whoever you command, including any allies willing to accept help from a corpse. Likewise, your ability to drain life from your foes to heal your flesh can also provide balm to allies willing to accept it. And should your group face an external necromantic threat, you have the knowledge and power to help confront it.
types.intro_es: La carne en descomposición irradia una fuerza vital que se apaga. Sabes absorber ese poder, retorcerlo y darle forma, y luego reinfundirlo en los muertos para que vuelvan a andar a tu servicio. También puedes extraer esa energía directamente de ellos para curar tu carne desgarrada o la de quien esté cerca. De hecho, tu dominio nigromántico te da cierto control sobre muertos vivientes de todo tipo: puedes aturdirlos, repelerlos o incluso mandarlos un rato. Como tus habilidades están tan ligadas a la muerte, mucha gente te teme y te odia sean cuales sean tus actos y tus verdaderos motivos. Tus ayudantes animados pueden ayudar a quien les mandes, incluidos los aliados dispuestos a aceptar ayuda de un cadáver. Del mismo modo, tu capacidad de drenar la vida de tus enemigos para curarte también puede aliviar a los aliados que lo acepten. Y si tu grupo se enfrenta a una amenaza nigromántica externa, tienes el saber y el poder para ayudar a combatirla.
ben_en: Able to take two more minor wounds and one more moderate wound
Add +4 to Intellect Pool
Add +1 Edge in Pool of your choice
Freely use light and medium weapons
Freely use light armor
Gain one weapon of your choice (or accept the equipment bundle weapon)
At tier 3 and tier 6, choose an ability from the Fantasy Genre Abilities list
ben_es: Puedes recibir dos heridas leves más y una moderada más
+4 a la reserva de Intelecto
+1 de Ventaja en la reserva que elijas
Usas libremente armas ligeras y medias
Usas libremente armaduras ligeras
Ganas un arma a tu elección (o aceptas la del lote de equipo)
En los rangos 3 y 6, elige una habilidad de la lista de habilidades del género fantasía
bg_en: When your spouse died, you dedicated your life to bringing them back, if not to life, then at least to a lifelike animated facsimile. But so far, it’s been failure upon failure.
About six months ago you animated a corpse that whispered your name before turning to dust.
You recently discovered there’s a bounty on you because you reportedly disturbed a graveyard.
After nearly dying as a young person, you decided that seeking immortality through unlife was your goal.
The dark school where you learned your craft was destroyed by lightning a few months ago.
Your sibling was found dead a year ago, apparently killed by an undead host.
You learned your craft from sigils scribed in the walls of ancient tombs, but now all the things buried there continually seek you out to “reclaim” what you stole.
Your friend remains angry that you failed to turn up for an important ceremony three months ago.
types.bundle_en: Choose the following equipment bundle to quickly outfit your character, or assemble your own starting equipment. A quarterstaff, appropriate clothing, a book of necrotic lore, a backpack, a bedroll, incense (10 sticks), matchsticks (10), a lantern, three days of rations and water, three flasks of oil, and enough extra currency to buy a moderately priced item.
types.bundle_es: Un bastón, ropa adecuada, un libro de saber necrótico, una mochila, un saco de dormir, incienso (10 varillas), cerillas (10), un farol, raciones y agua para tres días, tres frascos de aceite y dinero suficiente para comprar un objeto de precio moderado.

abilities.text_en: You animate the body of a dead creature of approximately your size or smaller within immediate range, creating a level 1 follower that is an undead creature. It has none of the intelligence, memories, or special abilities that it had in twist and shape it, then reinfuse the dead with them to heal your own rent flesh or anyone of all sorts, allowing you to daze and repel tethered to death, many people fear and hate you to accept help from a corpse. Likewise, your willing to accept it. And should your group face it. life. The creature follows your verbal commands until you use a one-hour or longer recovery, after which it becomes an inert corpse. Unless the creature is killed by damage, you can reanimate it again when its time expires, but any damage it had when it became inert applies to its newly reanimated state. If you use Basic Necromancy to animate a second body, any body you’ve already animated with this ability becomes an inert corpse again. Action to animate.
abilities.text_es: Animas el cuerpo de una criatura muerta de tu tamaño aproximado o menor a alcance inmediato y creas un seguidor de nivel 1 que es un muerto viviente. No tiene nada de la inteligencia, los recuerdos ni las habilidades especiales que tenía en vida. Sigue tus órdenes verbales hasta que hagas una recuperación de una hora o más, y entonces vuelve a ser un cadáver inerte. Si no lo mataron con daño, puedes reanimarlo de nuevo cuando se agote su tiempo, pero conserva el daño que tenía al quedar inerte. Si usas Nigromancia básica para animar un segundo cuerpo, el que ya habías animado vuelve a ser un cadáver inerte. Acción para animar.

abilities.text_en: You send forth an ashy tendril reaching up to short range, inflicting 2 damage to a living target with a successful Intellect attack roll. You benefit from their drained life, healing a minor wound from yourself or an ally within immediate range. Action. At tier 3: If you apply two levels of Effort, a successful attack inflicts 5 damage and heals a moderate or minor wound from yourself or an ally within immediate range.
abilities.text_es: Lanzas un zarcillo ceniciento hasta alcance corto que hace 2 de daño a un objetivo vivo si aciertas un ataque de Intelecto. Te beneficias de la vida drenada: curas una herida leve tuya o de un aliado a alcance inmediato. Acción. En el rango 3: si aplicas dos niveles de Esfuerzo, un ataque con éxito hace 5 de daño y cura una herida moderada o leve tuya o de un aliado a alcance inmediato.

abilities.text_en: You conjure pure spiritual energy to blast up to five undead, demons, and creatures of similar ilk of level 2 or less within short range. If you succeed on a separate Intellect attack against each foe, you choose whether they spend their next turn fleeing or lose their next turn. Effort: Increase the maximum level of the foe you can affect by 1. Specify some other action for the creatures to perform for one round, such as attacking a foe of your choice. Last action.
abilities.text_es: Conjuras energía espiritual pura y golpeas a hasta cinco muertos vivientes, demonios y criaturas similares de nivel 2 o inferior a alcance corto. Si superas un ataque de Intelecto aparte contra cada uno, eliges si pasan su siguiente turno huyendo o lo pierden. Esfuerzo: aumentas en 1 el nivel máximo de enemigo que puedes afectar. Indica otra acción que las criaturas deban hacer durante un asalto, como atacar a un enemigo que elijas. Última acción.

types.intro_en: By the power granted to you through righteous divine will, you protect and heal the innocent, drive out and destroy the servants of evil, and strive to live up to your oaths of honor and service. As witnessed before your god, you stand for justice and against the forces of corruption—usually delivered by the holy power you channel through your weapon. You’re among the first in your group to face your foes, seemingly fearless. You’re most effective in situations where your presence can draw the attention of your foes away from your allies, especially as your gods-given power can serve as a proactive defense.
types.intro_es: Con el poder que te concede la voluntad divina justa, proteges y curas a los inocentes, expulsas y destruyes a los siervos del mal, y te esfuerzas por cumplir tus juramentos de honor y servicio. Como atestiguó tu dios, defiendes la justicia contra las fuerzas de la corrupción, normalmente con el poder sagrado que canalizas a través de tu arma. Eres de los primeros de tu grupo en plantar cara al enemigo, aparentemente sin miedo. Rindes más cuando tu presencia aparta la atención de los enemigos de tus aliados, sobre todo porque el poder que te dan los dioses puede servir de defensa activa.
ben_en: Able to take three more minor wounds and one more moderate wound
Add +3 to Might Pool
Add +1 to Intellect Pool
Add +1 Edge in Pool of your choice
Freely use all weapons
Freely use all armor
Gain one weapon of your choice (or accept the equipment bundle weapon)
At tier 3 and tier 6, choose an ability from the Fantasy Genre Abilities list
ben_es: Puedes recibir tres heridas leves más y una moderada más
+3 a la reserva de Potencia
+1 a la reserva de Intelecto
+1 de Ventaja en la reserva que elijas
Usas libremente todas las armas
Usas libremente todas las armaduras
Ganas un arma a tu elección (o aceptas la del lote de equipo)
En los rangos 3 y 6, elige una habilidad de la lista de habilidades del género fantasía
bg_en: You were first called to service by a divine vision of a coming world-ending disaster. If you gather enough power in your god’s name, you believe you can avert it.
You served for years in a holy war in a faraway land, but returned home last month.
A few weeks ago, a seer claimed a demon was secretly attempting to corrupt you.
After your parents were slain by evil dragons, you took up their path to honor their lives (and slay evil dragons).
Last week you woke up with no memory at all of the preceding year.
You were discharged from the temple a year ago under a cloud of suspicion.
You were a simple priest until your temple was sacked. Then you took up the sword, driven by a zealous commitment to smite evil.
You triumphantly drove a nest of ghouls from the local graveyard a few weeks ago.    Currency, page 236 Moderately priced items, page 242
types.bundle_en: Choose the following equipment bundle to quickly outfit your character, or assemble your own starting equipment. A greatsword, appropriate clothing, chainmail armor, a holy symbol or portable shrine depicting the higher power you serve, a backpack, a bedroll, 50 feet (16 m) of rope, three torches, rations and water for three days, a tinderbox, and enough extra currency to buy a moderately priced item.
types.bundle_es: Un mandoble, ropa adecuada, cota de malla, un símbolo sagrado o un altar portátil del poder superior al que sirves, una mochila, un saco de dormir, 16 m de cuerda, tres antorchas, raciones y agua para tres días, un yesquero y dinero suficiente para comprar un objeto de precio moderado.

abilities.text_en: You add +1 damage to one type of weapon attack of your choice: melee weapon attacks or ranged weapon attacks.
abilities.text_es: Sumas +1 al daño de un tipo de ataque con arma a tu elección: cuerpo a cuerpo o a distancia.

abilities.text_en: While an ally within immediate range of you has at least three moderate wounds or at least one major wound, you can extend your divine grace, granting them one free level of Effort they can apply each round to an attack or defense roll. The divine grace they are afforded lasts until the wounds are healed or they use a ten-minute or longer recovery. innocent, drive out and destroy the servants your god, you stand for justice and against the weapon. most effective in situations where your presence power can serve as a proactive defense. Each time you use Holy Succor, the Intellect cost increases by 1. The cost returns to 1 after you take a recovery. Enabler.
abilities.text_es: Mientras un aliado a alcance inmediato tenga al menos tres heridas moderadas o una grave, puedes extender sobre él tu gracia divina: gana un nivel de Esfuerzo gratuito que puede aplicar cada asalto a una tirada de ataque o defensa. La gracia dura hasta que se curen las heridas o haga una recuperación de diez minutos o más. Cada vez que usas Socorro sagrado, el coste en Intelecto sube 1; vuelve a 1 cuando haces una recuperación. Enabler.

abilities.text_en: Choose one creature you can see that you want to be punished for their transgressions. Until you attack a different creature, your attacks against that creature deal +1 damage from divine energy coursing through your melee or ranged weapon. If the target is an undead creature, a demon, or of similar ilk as designated by your GM, you choose whether your successful attack inflicts +2 damage or your foe must flee from you for one turn. Enabler. At tier 3: The bonus damage against undead, demons, and similar ilk increases to +3.
abilities.text_es: Eliges una criatura que ves y que quieres que sea castigada por sus faltas. Hasta que ataques a otra criatura, tus ataques contra ella hacen +1 de daño por la energía divina que recorre tu arma cuerpo a cuerpo o a distancia. Si es un muerto viviente, un demonio o algo similar (según el DJ), eliges si tu ataque con éxito hace +2 de daño o si el enemigo debe huir de ti durante un turno. Enabler. En el rango 3: el daño extra contra muertos vivientes, demonios y similares sube a +3.

types.intro_en: You’re adept at traveling through perilous places. Hard experience has taught you that trust is something to be offered only rarely, and even then, might have to be traded for enmity. You know how to think like, track, and, if need be, bring down your prey, whether your quarry is wild game or someone you’ve determined must be hunted. Your ability to navigate is important in any group where travel to distant unknown regions and/or through mazelike tunnels under the earth happens with any sort of regularity. Your skill in finding the right path makes you invaluable anytime your group needs to track a foe who’s fled the scene and, once found, quickly dispatch them.
types.intro_es: Se te da bien viajar por lugares peligrosos. La dura experiencia te ha enseñado que la confianza se ofrece en contadas ocasiones, y aun así puede acabar convertida en enemistad. Sabes pensar como tu presa, rastrearla y, si hace falta, abatirla, ya sea caza salvaje o alguien al que has decidido perseguir. Tu capacidad de orientarte es importante en cualquier grupo que viaje con cierta frecuencia a regiones lejanas y desconocidas o por túneles laberínticos bajo tierra. Tu habilidad para encontrar el camino te hace imprescindible cuando el grupo tiene que seguir a un enemigo que ha huido y, una vez encontrado, acabar con él rápido.
ben_en: Able to take three more minor wounds and one more moderate wound
Add +1 to Might Pool
Add +2 to Speed Pool
Add +1 to Intellect Pool
Add +1 Edge in Pool of your choice
Freely use light and medium weapons
Freely use light and medium armor
Gain one weapon of your choice (or accept the equipment bundle weapon)
At tier 3 and tier 6, choose an ability from the Fantasy Genre Abilities list
ben_es: Puedes recibir tres heridas leves más y una moderada más
+1 a la reserva de Potencia
+2 a la reserva de Velocidad
+1 a la reserva de Intelecto
+1 de Ventaja en la reserva que elijas
Usas libremente armas ligeras y medias
Usas libremente armaduras ligeras y medias
Ganas un arma a tu elección (o aceptas la del lote de equipo)
En los rangos 3 y 6, elige una habilidad de la lista de habilidades del género fantasía
bg_en: Raised in the deepest wilds, your training was passed to you, and your duty is to one day pass that same training on to a worthy heir.
An old friend asked you to help someone in need, but you were never able to find them.
An enemy from your past recently tracked you down, but you lost them again.
You served as a scout for a frontier settlement. One day upon your return, it was gone as if it had never been. You still search, as possible, for what might have happened.
While serving as a bodyguard for a crime lord, you killed a city watch officer.
Your sibling was devoured by a monster when you were young. To this day, you’re motivated to hunt down and eliminate such creatures.
You still trade on the baroness’s gratitude for locating her missing son a few years ago.
You gained your strange scar exploring a dungeon, but you don’t remember how.
types.bundle_en: Choose the following equipment bundle to quickly outfit your character, or assemble your own starting equipment. A sword or bow (plus a quiver of 12 arrows), appropriate clothing, a compass, a backpack, a bedroll, 50 feet (16 m) of rope, a wineskin (full), three torches, rations and water for three days, a tinderbox, and enough extra currency to buy a moderately priced item.
types.bundle_es: Una espada o un arco (con un carcaj de 12 flechas), ropa adecuada, una brújula, una mochila, un saco de dormir, 16 m de cuerda, un odre (lleno), tres antorchas, raciones y agua para tres días, un yesquero y dinero suficiente para comprar un objeto de precio moderado.

abilities.text_en: You are trained in tracking. At tier 6: You can become an expert in tracking if you are already specialized, but you must gain the skill normally (such as from a character advancement).
abilities.text_es: Quedas entrenado en rastrear (tracking). En el rango 6: puedes hacerte experto en rastrear si ya estás especializado, pero tienes que ganar la habilidad de la forma normal (por ejemplo, con un avance).

abilities.text_en: When you are tracking a creature, have gotten lost, don’t know the first step to take to begin a journey, or are attempting to choose between two or more routes to take, you can ask your GM one question about the task and get a very short, helpful answer. Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until after your next recovery. Action.
abilities.text_es: Cuando rastreas a una criatura, te has perdido, no sabes cuál es el primer paso de un viaje o intentas elegir entre dos o más rutas, puedes hacer al DJ una pregunta sobre la tarea y recibir una respuesta útil y muy breve. Una vez usada, no puedes volver a usarla hasta después de tu siguiente recuperación. Acción.

abilities.text_en: Choose one creature you can see to be your quarry. You gain an asset on all tasks involving following, understanding, interacting with, attacking, or defending against your quarry. Your attacks against your quarry deal +1 damage. This benefit encompasses hunting-related tasks, if appropriate, such as skinning, dressing, the best way to prepare and preserve any resulting game meat, and so on. You can have only one quarry at a time. Action. At tier 3: You can have two quarries at a time.
abilities.text_es: Eliges como presa a una criatura que ves. Tienes un recurso a favor en todas las tareas de seguirla, entenderla, tratar con ella, atacarla o defenderte de ella, y tus ataques contra ella hacen +1 de daño. Incluye las tareas de caza, si procede: despellejar, limpiar, la mejor forma de preparar y conservar la carne, etc. Solo puedes tener una presa a la vez. Acción. En el rango 3: puedes tener dos presas a la vez.

types.intro_en: You’re crafty; some might even say shady. That’s because you survive risky endeavors with stealth, skill, and the grace that comes with quick reflexes. You size up the vulnerabilities of others with a glance, and when it’s in your best interest, exploit opportunities to their fullest. What you lack in brawn you more than make up for in guile, furtiveness, and maybe a little bit of luck. You prefer letting someone else in your group charge head-first into conflict, allowing you to slip past unnoticed, possibly so you can stick a dagger in an enemy’s back. When danger isn’t imminent, you’re among the best suited to carefully examine a new location and, if necessary, remediate traps and unlock vaults.
types.intro_es: Eres astuto; algunos dirían que turbio. Sobrevives a empresas arriesgadas gracias al sigilo, la habilidad y la gracia de unos reflejos rápidos. Calibras de un vistazo los puntos débiles de los demás y, cuando te conviene, aprovechas al máximo las oportunidades. Lo que te falta de músculo te sobra de picardía, disimulo y quizá un poco de suerte. Prefieres que otro de tu grupo se lance de cabeza al conflicto para colarte sin que te vean, quizá para clavarle una daga en la espalda a un enemigo. Cuando no hay peligro inminente, eres de los más indicados para examinar con cuidado un lugar nuevo y, si hace falta, desactivar trampas y abrir cámaras acorazadas.

bg_en: You got your start by working for a criminal guild and still retain an insatiable hunger for coin.
Last week you “helped” the city watch unlock a safe found in an abandoned wagon.
Your salvage of a sunken vessel in the harbor last month was interrupted by pirates.
Your father disappeared two weeks ago with no explanation.
You grew up on the streets, surviving on your wits, your nimble fingers, and the aid of a friend who later betrayed you nearly to your death. You still look for them.
You built up a small retail business. That ended when it burned down three months ago.
Raised a noble, you took up theft as an illicit “hobby” that grew out of control, and now lead something of a double life.
Your acquaintance the duke invited you to a grand party scheduled for next month.  60   CHAPTER 6  FANTASY GENRE
types.bundle_en: Choose the following equipment bundle to quickly outfit your character, or assemble your own starting equipment. Two daggers, appropriate clothing, a bag of light tools (including lockpicks), a backpack, a bedroll, 50 feet (16 m) of rope, a hand mirror, three torches, rations and water for three days, a tinderbox, and enough extra currency to buy a moderately priced item.

abilities.text_en: When you roll to find a trap and your roll is less than a 9, treat the roll as a 9. (This means you don’t get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1.) You retain your increased trap sensitivity until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery. Effort: Increase the minimum number rolled for this ability by 3. Action. At tier 3: The minimum number rolled for this ability increases to 12.
abilities.text_es: Cuando tiras para encontrar una trampa y sacas menos de 9, cuenta como un 9 (así que un 1 no provoca intrusión del DJ). Mantienes esta sensibilidad hasta que hagas una recuperación de diez minutos o más. Esfuerzo: sube en 3 el mínimo. Acción. En el rango 3: el mínimo pasa a 12.

abilities.text_en: You are trained in stealth. At tier 6: You can become an expert in stealth if you are already specialized, but you must gain the skill normally (such as from a character advancement).
abilities.text_es: Quedas entrenado en sigilo (stealth). En el rango 6: puedes hacerte experto en sigilo si ya estás especializado, pero tienes que ganar la habilidad de la forma normal (por ejemplo, con un avance).

abilities.text_en: If you use a light weapon to attack a foe under one of the following conditions, your attack inflicts +5 damage. (This ability doesn’t work with medium or heavy weapons.) • You attack with surprise. • An ally uses their action to ease your attack. • Your foe’s defenses are hindered due to some other ongoing direct distraction. • Your foe is unable to take their next turn due to some disabling attack or situation. First action.
abilities.text_es: Si atacas con un arma ligera en una de estas condiciones, tu ataque hace +5 de daño (no funciona con armas medias o pesadas): atacas por sorpresa; un aliado usa su acción para facilitarte el ataque; las defensas del enemigo están dificultadas por otra distracción directa; o el enemigo no puede hacer su siguiente turno por un ataque o situación incapacitante. Primera acción.

types.intro_en: You’re a War Arrow, a Hawkeye, a Death Whisper—or, as they sometimes call those like you, an Archer. You down your foes from afar with whistling bolts, one shot after another, before they have a chance to close. Even when foes bite, hew, and curse you in turn, your steady hand and long experience wielding a bow in combat allow your aim to remain true. You excel at ranged support for your allies, or sometimes downing foes from afar before hostilities have a chance to truly begin. You’re also adept at watching over an area for your next target, protecting others in your band with the threat of your nocked arrow.
types.intro_es: Eres una Flecha de Guerra, un Ojo de Halcón, un Susurro de Muerte o, como a veces llaman a los tuyos, un Arquero. Abates a tus enemigos desde lejos con saetas silbantes, un disparo tras otro, antes de que puedan acercarse. Aunque los enemigos te muerdan, te golpeen y te maldigan, tu pulso firme y tu larga experiencia con el arco en combate mantienen tu puntería. Destacas apoyando a tus aliados a distancia, o abatiendo enemigos antes de que empiece de verdad la lucha. También se te da bien vigilar una zona a la espera de tu siguiente blanco y proteger a tu grupo con la amenaza de tu flecha montada.

bg_en: You bow-hunted as a child to feed your family when your single parent was hurt by raiders— raiders who later burned your family’s home to the ground, killing all but you.
You won an archery contest a month ago despite allegations of cheating.
You were stranded in a forlorn desert keep for years until rescued two months ago.
You poached game from the royal forest to feed the starving (including yourself) until you were caught and served years in the dungeon. Recently, you escaped.
You were part of an expedition to retrieve a sacred artifact that went missing here a year ago.
A barbarian host saved your homeland from a dragon about six months earlier.
Every year a famed archery contest is held. One day you hope to enter and win it.
You found a weird arrow in a swamp-choked ruin a couple of weeks ago.

At tier 2: You can choose to become specialized in the same attack method you chose at tier 1, but you must gain the skill normally (such as from a character advancement). At tier 6: You can become an expert in a specific attack method (either the one you chose at tier 1 or another weapon skill you’re already specialized in), but you must gain the skill normally.
abilities.text_es: Quedas entrenado en un ataque con arma concreto a tu elección (espadas, hachas, arcos…) o en una categoría más amplia (armas contundentes ligeras, armas cortantes ligeras, armas a distancia ligeras, armas contundentes medias, cortantes medias, a distancia medias, etc.). En el rango 2: puedes especializarte en ese mismo método de ataque, pero tienes que ganar la habilidad de la forma normal (por ejemplo, con un avance). En el rango 6: puedes hacerte experto en un método de ataque concreto (el que elegiste en el rango 1 u otra habilidad de arma en la que ya estés especializado), pero tienes que ganarla de la forma normal.

abilities.text_en: You use a ranged weapon to target a limited area (such as a doorway, a hallway, or the eastern side of the clearing you’re in); as soon as a viable target enters the area, you can attack them. This works like delaying, but you also negate any benefit the target would have from cover, position, surprise, range, illumination, or visibility. Your attack inflicts +1 damage. You can remain on overwatch as long as you wish, within reason. Alternatively, you can use this ability against a target already in the limited area on your turn. Action.
abilities.text_es: Apuntas con un arma a distancia a una zona limitada (una puerta, un pasillo, el lado este del claro…) y, en cuanto entra un objetivo viable, puedes atacarlo. Funciona como retrasar la acción, pero además anulas cualquier beneficio que el objetivo tenga por cobertura, posición, sorpresa, distancia, iluminación o visibilidad. Tu ataque hace +1 de daño. Puedes mantener la vigilancia lo que quieras, dentro de lo razonable. También puedes usarla en tu turno contra un objetivo que ya esté en la zona. Acción.

abilities.text_en: Once per turn if you take down a foe with your medium or heavy ranged attack, you can immediately make another attack on that same turn against a new foe within short range as an extra action on your turn. Enabler.
abilities.text_es: Una vez por turno, si derribas a un enemigo con tu ataque a distancia medio o pesado, puedes hacer de inmediato otro ataque en ese mismo turno contra otro enemigo a alcance corto, como acción extra de tu turno. Enabler.

types.intro_en: When combat calls, your chosen weapon is a sturdy axe—maybe a handaxe, a battleaxe, or even a greataxe. Thus, they name you Deathhew, Axe Reaver, or maybe just what you are: an Axe Fighter. You’ve split many skulls with your axe, and if the gods continue to watch over you, many more will fall before you in the years ahead. Like others in your band, you’re ready for combat. You don’t mind if an ally gets in the first blow against cursed creatures you often face, because you know you’re more than capable of finishing the job with a final, sundering swing of your blade.
types.intro_es: Cuando llama el combate, tu arma es un hacha robusta: una de mano, una de batalla o incluso una gran hacha. Por eso te llaman Tajamuerte, Saqueador del Hacha o simplemente lo que eres: Luchador con hacha. Has partido muchos cráneos con ella y, si los dioses siguen velando por ti, muchos más caerán ante ti en los años venideros. Como los demás de tu banda, estás listo para el combate. No te importa que un aliado dé el primer golpe a las criaturas malditas con las que soléis toparos, porque sabes que eres más que capaz de rematar el trabajo con un último tajo demoledor.

bg_en: Raised in a forest-bound village, you took up your axe to fight encroaching dire wolves.
Six months ago in a miasmic jungle, you acquired a jade pommel for your axe.
Last week you returned to a merchant’s home for payment but found them dead.
A clan warrior, you were exiled from your mountainous homeland at age 16 for killing (or at least being accused of killing) your best friend.
A shrine to ancient, prehuman evils was discovered under your village a month ago.
Your axe is scratched from countless skirmishes during your years as a mercenary, but now you wish to pursue a new goal. You’re just not quite sure what.
The monstrous troll head you mounted as a trophy disappeared last week.
Your mother, who taught you the ways of the axe, went blind mysteriously a year ago.

abilities.text_en: This is an axe attack that relies on your axe’s “beard” (the portion of the blade directly below the axe’s cutting edge) to hook a target’s weapon or shield. A successful attack deals 2 less damage than normal but causes them to drop one or the other. To retrieve their weapon or shield, the target must use an action. Alternatively, you can hook a limb to pull your target off balance. This attack deals 1 less damage than normal but hinders your target’s tasks until your next turn. Action.
abilities.text_es: Atacas con la «barba» del hacha (la parte de la hoja justo debajo del filo) para enganchar el arma o el escudo del objetivo. Si aciertas, haces 2 de daño menos de lo normal, pero suelta una cosa u otra; para recuperarla tiene que usar una acción. También puedes enganchar una extremidad para desequilibrarlo: haces 1 de daño menos de lo normal, pero sus tareas quedan dificultadas hasta tu siguiente turno. Acción.

Your GM intrusion range for this attack increases by 2 (from 1 on a d20 to 1–3 on a d20), but if you hit you can choose one of the following additional effects: Brute Force: The foe takes +2 damage. Head Trauma: The attack inflicts 1 less damage, but the foe’s actions are hindered until they use an action to recover. Action.
abilities.text_es: Atacas con un hacha de una forma que arriesga más a fallar pero da un beneficio adicional. Tu rango de intrusión del DJ en este ataque sube en 2 (de 1 a 1–3 en el d20), pero si aciertas eliges uno de estos efectos adicionales. Fuerza bruta: el enemigo recibe +2 de daño. Traumatismo craneal: el ataque hace 1 de daño menos, pero las acciones del enemigo quedan dificultadas hasta que use una acción para reponerse. Acción.

types.intro_en: Adversaries (especially those who are sword trained) often underestimate someone armed only with daggers. If they challenge you, they learn their error when you flick a knife into their eye before they can even draw their oversized weapons. Maybe you prefer to be called a Quicksteel or a Shank, like some of your fellow students of the dagger, but in the end, Knife Fighter describes what you are as expeditiously as a knife thrust. You’re probably one more combatant in your group, though your ability to be among the first in a conflict to draw blood gives your comrades cover as they make their own attacks. It’s especially useful if you can pin a foe to the wall or floor for a moment, because that could signal to your allies who they should attack next.
types.intro_es: Los adversarios (sobre todo los entrenados con espada) suelen subestimar a alguien armado solo con dagas. Si te desafían, descubren su error cuando les clavas un cuchillo en el ojo antes de que desenvainen sus armas enormes. Quizá prefieres que te llamen Acero Veloz o Pincho, como algunos de tus compañeros estudiosos de la daga, pero al final Luchador con cuchillo describe lo que eres tan rápido como una cuchillada. Seguramente eres un combatiente más de tu grupo, aunque tu capacidad de ser de los primeros en hacer sangre cubre a tus compañeros mientras atacan. Es especialmente útil si puedes clavar a un enemigo a la pared o al suelo un momento, porque eso indica a tus aliados a quién atacar a continuación.

bg_en: You first picked up a knife as a street urchin in a sprawling city. You learned to be motivated by simple survival.
You were muscle on a job to con a wealthy merchant two weeks ago but never got paid.
A horrific extradimensional entity started whispering to you a year ago, but you mostly ignore it.
When your parents’ caravan was overrun, you spent years wandering treacherous wildlands with only a pet bear as your companion, until a hunter killed it.
You and your sister joined a bandit gang; after she was killed a year ago, you left the life behind.
Recently, the priest who took you in when you were orphaned died of a mysterious illness.
You recovered an inlaid metal chest from the old ruins weeks ago but still can’t get it open.
You were trained as an enforcer for a cutthroat gang and now want to retire from violence. However, the world leaves you no choice but to use your knife to survive.

abilities.text_en: Your successful ranged knife attack sticks in the target, catching in their clothing, their flesh, the floor, or another adjacent surface in a way that deals normal damage and hinders their tasks on their next turn. Action.
abilities.text_es: Tu ataque a distancia con cuchillo con éxito se queda clavado en el objetivo (en su ropa, su carne, el suelo u otra superficie cercana): hace el daño normal y dificulta sus tareas en su siguiente turno. Acción.

types.intro_en: You propitiate the dark ones, ancient entities, or possibly a very real and present god who will punish you if you fail to continue singing their praises and offering sacrifices. But in return for your worship and idolatry, you can call upon their antediluvian aid, allowing you to manifest inexplicable powers to heal, enhance, cleanse, or punish. Your allies count on you to interpret strange dreams, identify lost gods and their works, heal and ward them against malign influences, and, when it matters most, step into a fight with your magic or weapon. You’ve journeyed long and far enough to know that the capacity to strike a foe down with an axe or sword is just as much a blessing as magic, as long as thanks are given afterward.
types.intro_es: Aplacas a los oscuros, a entidades antiguas o quizá a un dios muy real y presente que te castigará si dejas de cantar sus alabanzas y hacerle sacrificios. Pero a cambio de tu culto e idolatría puedes invocar su ayuda antediluviana y manifestar poderes inexplicables para curar, potenciar, purificar o castigar. Tus aliados cuentan contigo para interpretar sueños extraños, identificar dioses perdidos y sus obras, curarlos y protegerlos de influencias malignas y, cuando más importa, entrar en la lucha con tu magia o tu arma. Has viajado lo bastante para saber que la capacidad de abatir a un enemigo con hacha o espada es tanta bendición como la magia, siempre que luego se den las gracias.

bg_en: Your natural carving talent was so advanced that the gods noticed you even as a child.
A year ago another priest predicted you would soon die in a bloody, surprising manner.
An idol you gave to a barbarian warlord was returned to you recently, bloodstained and hewn.
A message from your father arrived a few weeks ago, demanding that you return to your homeland.
Missionaries in an obscure faith raised you. Now you hope to spread the good word as far and wide as possible to grow your faith’s reach.
You woke in a tomb this morning. You got out but don’t remember how you got there.
Last month you cast out a demon that was possessing a bandit. Their promised reward is still pending.
You believe the gods keep claiming credit for your innate magical abilities. One day you hope to cut them out entirely, but until then, you repeat their dogmas to the gullible.
types.bundle_en: Choose the following equipment bundle to quickly outfit your character, or assemble your own starting equipment. A battleaxe, appropriate clothing, chainmail armor, a shield, a backpack, a bedroll, 50 feet (16 m) of rope, a book of prayers, three torches, rations and water for three days, a tinderbox, and enough extra currency to buy a moderately priced item.

abilities.text_es: Puedes llevar una cifra más a la vez.

abilities.text_en: At the conclusion of a ten-minute ritual, you create an idol that persists until its magic is exhausted. The idol could be a symbol etched in stone, a figurine woven from twigs, a small carving, or something similar. The idol must be set on a solid surface with a nod toward being protected from the elements, such as being set in a tree hollow, at the base of a wall, or inside a structure. The idol’s holy connection to the ineffable provides your choice of one of the following fixed benefits. Whoever prays to the idol as their action gains this benefit whether you are present or not. The idol has
abilities.text_es: Al terminar un ritual de diez minutos creas un ídolo que dura hasta que se agota su magia: un símbolo grabado en piedra, una figurilla tejida con ramitas, una pequeña talla o algo parecido. Debe colocarse en una superficie sólida algo protegida de los elementos, como el hueco de un árbol, la base de un muro o el interior de un edificio. Su vínculo sagrado con lo inefable da, a tu elección, uno de estos beneficios fijos; quien rece al ídolo como su acción lo recibe, estés o no presente. El ídolo tiene un agotamiento de 1–2 en 1d6: tira cada vez que da su beneficio a alguien. Furia bestial: el suplicante queda imbuido de un espíritu latente de furia bestial, que se activa cuando pierde los nervios o cuando decide despertarlo como acción extra de su turno. Al surgir la furia, se transforma visiblemente en una versión hinchada y rabiosa de sí mismo. Mientras dura, no puede gastar puntos de Intelecto salvo para intentar recuperar la compostura; ataca a toda criatura viva a alcance corto, tirando dos veces por ataque y quedándose con el mejor resultado. Dura hasta que haga una recuperación de diez minutos o más o use una acción para superar una tarea de Intelecto de dificultad 2. Al volver a la normalidad, el desgaste físico le causa dos heridas moderadas. (Un PNJ suplicante furioso es de hecho un nivel superior y recibe 6 de daño al acabar la furia.) Curación: la gravedad de una de las heridas del suplicante baja un paso (un PNJ recupera 5 de salud). Purificación espiritual: el suplicante se libra de una maldición, posesión demoníaca o aflicción espiritual similar de nivel 5 o inferior. Esfuerzo: puedes llevar el ídolo contigo. Diez minutos para iniciar.

abilities.text_en: You call forth the powers of a deity to assail a foe within short range that you can see. If your Intellect attack hits, the target takes 3 damage; they are also marked with an obvious sign relating to that deity until you take a ten-minute or longer recovery. For example, if you call for the retribution of Thesk the Serpent Lord, the attack looks like ephemeral snakes twining around and biting your foe, and they are marked on their forehead or another obvious location with glowing fangs or a snake’s head. Last action. The retribution increases to 5 damage.
abilities.text_es: Invocas los poderes de una deidad contra un enemigo que ves a alcance corto. Si aciertas el ataque de Intelecto, recibe 3 de daño y queda marcado con un signo evidente de esa deidad hasta que hagas una recuperación de diez minutos o más. Por ejemplo, si invocas la retribución de Thesk el Señor de las Serpientes, el ataque parece de serpientes etéreas que se enroscan y muerden al enemigo, y queda marcado en la frente u otro lugar visible con colmillos o una cabeza de serpiente brillantes. Última acción. En el rango 3: la retribución sube a 5 de daño.

types.intro_en: You’re one of the rare few. You have the aptitude, inborn talent, and capacity to confer with dark entities without losing your mind, allowing you to unlock and command magic. Most people gaze upon you with fear when they realize your abilities are not mere pageantry, but instead the secrets of a forgotten age reborn in you. When you open your inner eye, your mind expands, allowing you to see the unseen, bend others to your will, and lash their minds directly. Your magic is useful in a fight, especially since you don’t need to physically strike your foes to harm or sway them; however, you lean on others in your group to provide physical security lest you be overrun by mere force before you have a chance to shine. Outside a conflict, your deeper knowledge of ancient, sorcerous lore may spell the difference between a successful foray and an early grave.
types.intro_es: Eres uno de los pocos. Tienes la aptitud, el talento innato y la capacidad de tratar con entidades oscuras sin perder la cabeza, lo que te permite desvelar y dominar la magia. La mayoría te mira con miedo cuando descubre que tus habilidades no son mero espectáculo, sino los secretos de una era olvidada renacidos en ti. Cuando abres tu ojo interior, tu mente se expande: ves lo invisible, doblegas a otros a tu voluntad y fustigas directamente sus mentes. Tu magia es útil en combate, sobre todo porque no necesitas golpear físicamente para dañar o influir; pero dependes de tu grupo para la seguridad física, no vayan a arrollarte por la fuerza antes de que puedas brillar. Fuera del combate, tu profundo saber hechicero antiguo puede marcar la diferencia entre una incursión con éxito y una tumba temprana.

bg_en: When you woke from a ten-year coma as a young adult, you had your abilities but no memories of your past. Now you hope to recover them if possible.
Rumors suggest the small kingdom where you were born fell to shadows a year ago.
You changed your name and look six months ago after being accused of necromancy.
The thieves’ guild sometimes contracts your services during interrogations.
Your grandmother had the sight too, until assassins of the crown killed her. So you try to keep your abilities hidden, biding your time until you can claim your revenge.
You sometimes dream of a “smiling man” whose whispers threaten madness.

A monstrous alien species kidnapped you and performed strange tests on you, and when they released you, you had your abilities. You’re afraid they also may have changed you in other ways that are still not apparent.
You had a child who grew to adulthood, joined a war, and died three years ago.
types.bundle_en: Choose the following equipment bundle to quickly outfit your character, or assemble your own starting equipment. A dagger, appropriate clothing, a book of lore, a backpack, a bedroll, incense (ten sticks), matchsticks (ten), a magnifying glass, three torches, two flasks of oil, rations and water for three days, and enough extra currency to buy a moderately priced item.
types.bundle_es: Una daga, ropa adecuada, un libro de saber, una mochila, un saco de dormir, incienso (diez varillas), cerillas (diez), una lupa, tres antorchas, dos frascos de aceite, raciones y agua para tres días y dinero suficiente para comprar un objeto de precio moderado.

abilities.text_en: You can bear one additional cypher at a time.
abilities.text_es: Puedes llevar una cifra más a la vez.

abilities.text_en: After a ten-minute ritual that concludes by you or an ally puncturing your forehead with a blade (inflicting a minor wound), you can peer into the spiritual realm until you use a ten-hour recovery. While your inner eye is open, your perception tasks in physical reality are hindered, but you gain additional abilities. While your inner eye is open, you can use any of the following abilities, paying the Pool point cost for each use. • Detect Spirit (2+ Intellect): Make an Intellect roll to scan for mental presences of living creatures and undead spirits within short range. You detect any such creature whose level is equal to or less than the level of your result. Barriers of higher level than the level of your result block this sense. Effort: Until your next turn you can pinpoint those presences in physical space. Action. • Mindslice (1 Intellect): You mentally attack a target you can see within short range, focusing your mind to blast their thoughts for 2 damage (ignores armor). Creatures without minds (such as relatively mindless undead) might be immune. Action. • Sorcerous Suggestion (2 Intellect): If you succeed on an Intellect attack against a creature with a mind, on their next turn they attempt one of the following actions that you specify: identify themself, say why they are present, close or open a door or container, drop something or pick something up, move an immediate distance, pass something they’re holding to you, or just stand quietly and do nothing. Action. Ten minutes to activate (one minute to activate at tier 3 and higher). At tier 3: The time you need to activate the ritual is reduced to one minute and your perception tasks in the real world are no longer hindered.
abilities.text_es: Tras un ritual de diez minutos que termina con un corte en tu frente (hecho por ti o por un aliado, que te causa una herida leve), puedes asomarte al reino espiritual hasta que hagas una recuperación de diez horas. Mientras tienes el ojo interior abierto, tus tareas de percepción en la realidad física quedan dificultadas, pero ganas habilidades adicionales que puedes usar pagando su coste cada vez. Detectar espíritus (2+ Intelecto): haces una tirada de Intelecto para buscar presencias mentales de criaturas vivas y espíritus muertos vivientes a alcance corto; detectas a las de nivel igual o inferior al nivel de tu resultado, y las barreras de nivel superior lo bloquean. Esfuerzo: hasta tu siguiente turno las ubicas en el espacio físico. Acción. Tajo mental (1 Intelecto): atacas mentalmente a un objetivo que ves a alcance corto y le haces 2 de daño (ignora la armadura); las criaturas sin mente (como los muertos vivientes casi sin mente) pueden ser inmunes. Acción. Sugestión hechicera (2 Intelecto): si superas un ataque de Intelecto contra una criatura con mente, en su siguiente turno intenta una de estas acciones que tú indiques: identificarse, decir por qué está ahí, abrir o cerrar una puerta o recipiente, soltar o coger algo, moverse una distancia inmediata, pasarte algo que lleve, o quedarse quieta sin hacer nada. Acción. Diez minutos para activar (un minuto desde el rango 3). En el rango 3: el ritual solo te lleva un minuto y tus tareas de percepción en el mundo real ya no quedan dificultadas.

types.intro_en: In some lands, you’re known as a Swordsworn, a Steelhand, or a Blade Master. You don’t care about a showy name—you just prefer to fight with a sword. You’ve fought with your sword for thousands of hours while training, in war, on expeditions, and during desperate battles in forgotten places of the world. Maybe you fight as a mercenary, for yourself, or as part of a group of adventurers. As long as you’ve got your sword, nothing can withstand you. You are up for a fight anytime, even when startled directly from sleep. Sword held high, you’re ready to protect your allies, even if that means drawing your foes’ attention. So be it; they’ll meet you at your sword’s edge.
types.intro_es: En algunas tierras te conocen como Juramentado de la Espada, Manoacero o Maestro de la Hoja. No te importan los nombres vistosos: simplemente prefieres luchar con espada. Has peleado con ella miles de horas entrenando, en la guerra, en expediciones y en batallas desesperadas en rincones olvidados del mundo. Quizá luchas como mercenario, por tu cuenta o en un grupo de aventureros. Mientras tengas tu espada, nada te resiste. Estás listo para pelear en cualquier momento, incluso si te despiertan de golpe. Con la espada en alto, estás preparado para proteger a tus aliados, aunque eso suponga atraer la atención de tus enemigos. Que así sea: te encontrarán en el filo de tu espada.

bg_en: You grew to adulthood as a pit fighter who lived by your sword until you escaped, but your former “employers” still hunt for you.
Some weeks back you rescued an ally from a sorcerer’s enchanted tower.
You racked up a considerable gambling debt a few months ago, still unpaid.
Born into a royal house, you were disowned after too many reckless duels, but you hope to return one day and seize your birthright.
Your sibling was on a ship that disappeared on a journey across the misted sea last year.
You fled the war, not because you were afraid to fight, but because you were press-ganged into service by the enemy force when you were young.
The one who hired you to recover an artifact died last month before the mission started.
A cult of rat worshipers tried to kidnap your family last year, but you burned out their den.

abilities.text_es: Sumas +1 al daño de un tipo de ataque con arma a tu elección: cuerpo a cuerpo o a distancia.

abilities.text_es: Quedas entrenado en un ataque con arma concreto a tu elección (espadas, hachas, arcos…) o en una categoría más amplia (armas contundentes ligeras, armas cortantes ligeras, armas a distancia ligeras, armas contundentes medias, cortantes medias, a distancia medias, etc.). abilities.text_en: You attack with a sword in a way that has a greater risk of making an error but gains an additional benefit. Your GM intrusion range for this attack increases by 2 (from 1 on a d20 to 1–3 on a d20), but if you hit you can choose one of the following additional effects: Eat Steel: The foe takes +2 damage. Slice and Step: You reposition your foe or yourself an immediate distance away, easing your attack on your next turn (whether against that foe or a different one). Action.
abilities.text_es: Atacas con una espada de una forma que arriesga más a fallar pero da un beneficio adicional. Tu rango de intrusión del DJ en este ataque sube en 2 (de 1 a 1–3 en el d20), pero si aciertas eliges uno de estos efectos adicionales. Come acero: el enemigo recibe +2 de daño. Corte y paso: recolocas al enemigo o a ti mismo a distancia inmediata, lo que facilita tu ataque en tu siguiente turno (contra ese enemigo u otro). Acción.

types.intro_en: You’ll cop to Thief, but you’re also a finagler, a swindler, and someone able to perform tricks that go beyond mere sleight of hand (or so you tell everyone). More importantly, you’re deadly with a blade when your tricks go wrong, but especially if you gain the drop on someone. You’re no hulking warrior—rather, your feline grace allows you to slip into and out of danger with nary a scratch. The same can’t be said of your foes. You prefer to let others in your band jump headlong into a fight, allowing you to bypass the threat altogether, or perhaps deliver a decisive blow from behind. You’re a natural when it comes to checking out new areas, disarming traps, and cracking open secure containers.
types.intro_es: Admites lo de Ladrón, pero también eres un enredador, un timador y alguien capaz de hacer trucos que van más allá de la simple prestidigitación (o eso le cuentas a todo el mundo). Y lo más importante: eres letal con una hoja cuando tus trucos salen mal, sobre todo si pillas a alguien desprevenido. No eres un guerrero corpulento; tu gracia felina te permite entrar y salir del peligro sin un rasguño. No puede decirse lo mismo de tus enemigos. Prefieres dejar que otros de tu banda se lancen de cabeza a la pelea, para esquivar la amenaza por completo o quizá asestar un golpe decisivo por la espalda. Tienes un don natural para explorar zonas nuevas, desactivar trampas y abrir contenedores cerrados.

bg_en: Your parents sold you to the thieves’ guild to pay off debts, but you hope to find them one day and get the story from them.
You’ve been living under a false identity for a year since a disastrous night of thievery.
Two months ago you stole a fabulous jewel but have since discovered it’s too hot to fence.
Pursued by vengeful cultists six months ago, you discovered a strange ruin in the forest.
You came from a distant land and, unable to speak the language at first, learned to steal to live. You’re in a better place now but have some scores to settle.
You killed a vile sorcerer two years ago, but now their child seeks vengeance.
Your patron has an amazing, uplifting plan, but it requires a large fortune to get off the ground, and thieving is how you’ve been helping to contribute.
Lured by the promise of riches, you were lost in a labyrinth for months, only recently escaping.
